question: When an article is sold for Rs. 531, there is a gain of 18%, If it is sold for Rs. 486, then there will be a
solution:
Given: 

Selling price = Rs. 531

Gain = 18%

Concept used:

Selling price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Gain%

Calculation:

Let the cost price be Rs. Q.

According to the question,

Q + Q × 18% = 531

⇒ Q = 450

So, the gain % = (486 - 450)/450 × 100% = 8%

**∴ If it is sold for Rs. 486, then there will be a gain of 8%.**

Gain % = (486 - 450)/450 × 100% = +8% 

∴ If it is sold for Rs. 486, then there will be a gain of 8%.
